No source read confirms that the HHS task force was disbanded, that a pro-life task force was installed, that the HHS mission or strategic plan was reworded, or that a Special Representative for Domestic Women's Health was created.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14182 (Enforcing the Hyde Amendment) revoked Executive Orders 14076 and 14079, the 2022 orders on reproductive healthcare access.

title: Replace HHS reproductive access task force with a pro-life task force and mission language
uncertainties: The order text was re-read in review: Executive Order 14182, signed 2025-01-24, revokes Executive Orders 14076 and 14079 and does not mention HHS, a task force or a strategic plan. The HHS Reproductive Healthcare Access Task Force was an HHS-level body, and no HHS document disbanding it was found; revoking the underlying orders removes its policy basis but is not confirmation that it was eliminated. HHS web pages for the task force, strategic plan or any women's health representative were not found; search results returned only older strategic plan commentary from 2017 and 2018 and advocacy summaries, which were not used. Searches run: task force disbanded query; special representative and strategic plan query.
